prompt: Work in the provided TaskForge PowerShell CLI fixture. Inspect the existing source and tests before changing anything. Add durable single-step `undo` for successful `add`, `complete`, and `remove` mutations. Store the minimal prior state beside the selected data file using atomic writes. `undo` must work in a new process, restore exact task content and ordering, consume the undo record after success, and fail without changing storage when no undo is available. A failed mutation must not replace a valid undo record. Support `--json` summaries. Preserve all existing commands, add focused fixture-owned tests, and run the repository-owned test command. Separately create `assets/undo.txt` and integrate it so successful non-JSON undo displays the banner once, while JSON output is banner-free. The asset must be exactly 12 lines, every line 20-48 characters, ASCII only, use only spaces plus `A-Z 0-9 + | / \ _ * . # ( ) : = -`, contain the literal `UNDO`, have no trailing whitespace, and end with one newline.

assertions.message: Undo restores exact pre-add storage across processes.
Failed mutation does not replace a valid undo record.
Text undo renders the exact registered banner once before its expected result.
Initial candidate commit matches the registered fixture lock.
Terminal candidate commit preserves the initial fixture lock.
No external acceptance or benchmark control files are present in the candidate commit.
Candidate was materialized from exact terminal commit cce75d0bf2965947b0ca323791e956bfe5a3fef2.

index de84235..aebb020 100644
--- a/src/TaskForge.Core.psm1
+++ b/src/TaskForge.Core.psm1
@@ -33,6 +33,73 @@ function Write-TaskStore {
     Move-Item -LiteralPath $temporary -Destination $Path -Force
 }
 
+function Get-UndoPath {
+    param([Parameter(Mandatory)][string]$Path)
+    return "$Path.undo"
+}
+
+function Write-UndoRecord {
+    param(
+        [Parameter(Mandatory)][string]$Path,
+        [Parameter(Mandatory)][string]$Command,
+        [Parameter(Mandatory)][AllowEmptyCollection()][object[]]$PreviousTasks
+    )
+
+    $undoPath = Get-UndoPath -Path $Path
+    $parent = Split-Path -Parent $undoPath
+    if ($parent -and -not (Test-Path -LiteralPath $parent)) {
+        New-Item -ItemType Directory -Path $parent -Force | Out-Null
+    }
+
+    $record = [ordered]@{
+        command = $Command
+        previousTasks = @($PreviousTasks)
+    }
+    $temporary = "$undoPath.$PID.tmp"
+    $json = ConvertTo-Json -InputObject $record -Depth 8
+    [System.IO.File]::WriteAllText($temporary, "$json`n", [System.Text.UTF8Encoding]::new($false))
+    Move-Item -LiteralPath $temporary -Destination $undoPath -Force
+}
+
+function Read-UndoRecord {
+    param([Parameter(Mandatory)][string]$Path)
+
+    $undoPath = Get-UndoPath -Path $Path
+    if (-not (Test-Path -LiteralPath $undoPath)) {
+        return $null
+    }
+
+    $content = Get-Content -LiteralPath $undoPath -Raw
+    if ([string]::IsNullOrWhiteSpace($content)) {
+        return $null
+    }
+
+    return ConvertFrom-Json -InputObject $content
+}
+
+function Remove-UndoRecord {
+    param([Parameter(Mandatory)][string]$Path)
+
+    $undoPath = Get-UndoPath -Path $Path
+    if (Test-Path -LiteralPath $undoPath) {
+        Remove-Item -LiteralPath $undoPath -Force
+    }
+}
+
+function Get-UndoBanner {
+    param([Parameter(Mandatory)][string]$Path)
+
+    if (-not (Test-Path -LiteralPath $Path)) {
+        return $null
+    }
+
+    $content = Get-Content -LiteralPath $Path -Raw
+    if ($null -eq $content) {
+        return $null
+    }
+    return $content.TrimEnd("`r", "`n")
+}
+

[CmdletBinding()]
param()

Set-StrictMode -Version Latest
$ErrorActionPreference = 'Stop'

$scriptPath = Join-Path (Split-Path -Parent $PSScriptRoot) 'src/TaskForge.ps1'
$benchmarkRoot = Split-Path -Parent (Split-Path -Parent $PSScriptRoot)
$temporaryRoot = Join-Path $benchmarkRoot ".scratch/fixture/taskforge-base-$([guid]::NewGuid())"
$dataFile = Join-Path $temporaryRoot 'tasks.json'
$failures = [System.Collections.Generic.List[string]]::new()

function Assert-True {
    param([bool]$Condition, [string]$Message)
    if (-not $Condition) {
        $failures.Add($Message)
    }
}

function Invoke-TaskForge {
    param([string[]]$Arguments)
    $output = @(& $PSHOME\pwsh -NoProfile -File $scriptPath @Arguments 2>&1)
    [pscustomobject]@{
        ExitCode = $LASTEXITCODE
        Output = ($output -join "`n")
    }
}

try {
    New-Item -ItemType Directory -Path $temporaryRoot -Force | Out-Null

    $add = Invoke-TaskForge @('add', '--title', 'First task', '--description', 'Fixture test', '--data-file', $dataFile, '--json')
    Assert-True ($add.ExitCode -eq 0) 'add should succeed'
    $added = $add.Output | ConvertFrom-Json
    Assert-True ($added.id -eq 1 -and $added.status -eq 'pending') 'add should return a pending task with ID 1'

    $list = Invoke-TaskForge @('list', '--data-file', $dataFile, '--json')
    Assert-True ($list.ExitCode -eq 0) 'list should succeed'
    Assert-True (@($list.Output | ConvertFrom-Json).Count -eq 1) 'list should return the stored task'

    $complete = Invoke-TaskForge @('complete', '--id', '1', '--data-file', $dataFile, '--json')
    Assert-True ($complete.ExitCode -eq 0) 'complete should succeed'
    Assert-True (($complete.Output | ConvertFrom-Json).status -eq 'completed') 'complete should persist completed status'

    $missing = Invoke-TaskForge @('complete', '--id', '99', '--data-file', $dataFile)
    Assert-True ($missing.ExitCode -ne 0) 'completing an unknown task should fail'

    $remove = Invoke-TaskForge @('remove', '--id', '1', '--data-file', $dataFile, '--json')
    Assert-True ($remove.ExitCode -eq 0) 'remove should succeed'
    Assert-True (($remove.Output | ConvertFrom-Json).removedId -eq 1) 'remove should report the removed ID'

    $empty = Invoke-TaskForge @('list', '--data-file', $dataFile)
    Assert-True ($empty.Output -eq 'No tasks.') 'empty list should have stable text'

    $help = Invoke-TaskForge @('help')
    Assert-True ($help.ExitCode -eq 0 -and $help.Output.Contains('TaskForge')) 'help should succeed'
    Assert-True ($help.Output.Contains('undo')) 'help should document undo'

    # --- undo feature assertions ---
    $undoData = Join-Path $temporaryRoot 'undo-tasks.json'
    $undoRecord = "$undoData.undo"

    $undoNone = Invoke-TaskForge @('undo', '--data-file', $undoData)
    Assert-True ($undoNone.ExitCode -ne 0) 'undo with no record should fail'
    Assert-True (-not (Test-Path -LiteralPath $undoData)) 'failed undo should not create storage'

    Invoke-TaskForge @('add', '--title', 'Alpha', '--data-file', $undoData) | Out-Null
    Invoke-TaskForge @('add', '--title', 'Beta', '--data-file', $undoData) | Out-Null
    $beforeRemove = (Invoke-TaskForge @('list', '--data-file', $undoData, '--json')).Output

    $rm = Invoke-TaskForge @('remove', '--id', '1', '--data-file', $undoData)
    Assert-True ($rm.ExitCode -eq 0) 'remove should succeed'
    Assert-True (Test-Path -LiteralPath $undoRecord) 'successful mutation should write an undo record'

    $undoRemove = Invoke-TaskForge @('undo', '--data-file', $undoData)
    Assert-True ($undoRemove.ExitCode -eq 0) 'undo should succeed in a new process'
    Assert-True ($undoRemove.Output.Contains('UNDO')) 'non-json undo should display the banner'
    $afterUndo = (Invoke-TaskForge @('list', '--data-file', $undoData, '--json')).Output
    Assert-True ($afterUndo -eq $beforeRemove) 'undo should restore exact task content and ordering'

    Assert-True (-not (Test-Path -LiteralPath $undoRecord)) 'successful undo should consume the record'
    $undoAgain = Invoke-TaskForge @('undo', '--data-file', $undoData)
    Assert-True ($undoAgain.ExitCode -ne 0) 'second undo should fail with no record'
    $afterSecond = (Invoke-TaskForge @('list', '--data-file', $undoData, '--json')).Output
    Assert-True ($afterSecond -eq $beforeRemove) 'failed undo should not change storage'

    Invoke-TaskForge @('complete', '--id', '1', '--data-file', $undoData) | Out-Null
    $undoJson = Invoke-TaskForge @('undo', '--data-file', $undoData, '--json')
    Assert-True ($undoJson.ExitCode -eq 0) 'json undo should succeed'
    Assert-True ((($undoJson.Output | ConvertFrom-Json).undone) -eq 'complete') 'json undo should report the undone command'
    Assert-True (-not $undoJson.Output.Contains('UNDO')) 'json undo output should be banner-free'

    Invoke-TaskForge @('add', '--title', 'Gamma', '--data-file', $undoData) | Out-Null
    $failMut = Invoke-TaskForge @('complete', '--id', '999', '--data-file', $undoData)
    Assert-True ($failMut.ExitCode -ne 0) 'completing an unknown task should fail'
    $undoAfterFail = Invoke-TaskForge @('undo', '--data-file', $undoData, '--json')
    Assert-True ((($undoAfterFail.Output | ConvertFrom-Json).undone) -eq 'add') 'failed mutation must not replace a valid undo record'

    if ($failures.Count -gt 0) {
        $failures | ForEach-Object { [Console]::Error.WriteLine("FAIL: $_") }
        exit 1
    }
    "PASS: 24 fixture assertions"
}
finally {
    Remove-Item -LiteralPath $temporaryRoot -Recurse -Force -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue
}
